vision: The smallest possible Flutter beauty shop demo that runs on an Android emulator in under 10 minutes. It lets us show the core shopping experience (browse products, view a product, add to cart) using hard-coded local data, so we can get a quick, tangible feel for the app before investing in a full build.
target_users: Me and my internal team (business owner, merchandising and marketing staff) who need to see a working beauty shopping app quickly
Developers and designers who will run the demo on an Android emulator and build on it in later milestones
Future shoppers: beauty-conscious customers browsing on their phones (not served by this demo, but it informs the layout and flow)
business_goals: Get a working, runnable demo in under 10 minutes so we can validate the basic browse-to-detail-to-cart flow
Prove the Flutter approach works with zero backend, so `flutter run` works immediately after scaffold
Keep scope as small as possible: only the listed requirements, nothing extra
Give us something concrete to react to so we can decide what to build in the next milestone
Avoid any work item that waits on human, style or stakeholder approval; the team makes sensible decisions and keeps moving
key_features: Browse screen: a grid of 6-8 hard-coded beauty products, each showing name, price, and an image URL or placeholder color. My decision: 8 products with placeholder colors as the default so it works offline, with prices in USD, e.g. lipstick, foundation, mascara, face serum, moisturizer, perfume, nail polish, and a makeup brush set
Product detail screen: tap a product on the grid to see its name, price, and a short description
Optional: Add to cart button on the detail screen that keeps items in memory only and shows a cart count (for example a badge on the browse screen app bar); no checkout
Mock/local data only, so the app runs immediately after scaffold with no setup
constraints: Flutter-only for the first milestone; no NestJS or backend required to run the demo
No auth, payments, accounts, or API integration
No checkout flow; cart is in memory only and resets when the app restarts
Must run on an Android emulator in under 10 minutes from start
Use only hard-coded mock/local data so `flutter run` works right after scaffold
Do NOT create any work item waiting on human, style or stakeholder approval
Scope is limited to the three listed requirements only
open_questions: Should we use real product images via URLs in a later milestone, or keep placeholder colors? Not decided; placeholder colors for now
Should the cart count be tappable to show a cart contents screen in a later milestone? Not decided
Should the cart support quantities and removing items? Not decided; out of scope for this milestone
What currency, pricing and real product catalog will we use once the demo moves beyond mock data? Not decided
When do we add a backend, accounts and payments, and in what order? Not decided; to be revisited after the demo
Do we need iOS support or only Android for the next milestone? Not decided
